summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around federal infrastructure execution rather than headline policy beneficiaries. The most relevant underfollowed lane is not defense primes but contractors with backlog, qualified labor, government-customer exposure, marine/base/facility capabilities, and working-capital tolerance. Candidates are included as research leads only, not recommendations. Key risk: many contractors convert revenue into thin or volatile margins because of fixed-price execution, claims, labor availability, and government-funding timing.
